title: Rulebook
description: The part of our rules one probe applies, read once by the reviewing context and handed over whole: the rules to probe, the principles that answer when the application of a rule is in doubt, and the glossary that defines their terms

rules.description: The rules handed over, in order. A probe writes one ledger row for each rule of the rulebook it probes

principles.description: The principle each listed rule names as its parent

definitions.description: The glossary definition of every [[term]] a listed rule, principle, or definition names. A rule is applied as the glossary defines its terms

rules.body: Discard a command's non-zero [[Exit status]] so that a failure passes as success.

principles.body: A system fails loudly and at once on an unexpected state; it never continues on a guess.

definitions.specification: The number a process returns when it ends; zero means success, anything else failure.
